title.zh: SEC moves to clear custody hurdle for advisers offering crypto
title.en: SEC moves to clear custody hurdle for advisers offering crypto

current_state.zh: The SEC proposed easing custody rules so investment advisers can hold client crypto themselves when no eligible custodian exists and allowing state trust companies to serve as crypto custodians, removing a key hurdle for advisers offering digital assets.
current_state.en: The SEC proposed easing custody rules so investment advisers can hold client crypto themselves when no eligible custodian exists and allowing state trust companies to serve as crypto custodians, removing a key hurdle for advisers offering digital assets.
